A '''Torture Chamber''' was a cell, at least ten meters across, that could be located onboard the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']] in the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]. It was filled with [[Species/Legends|organic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] torture devices, including an [[Embrace of Pain]]. It was connected to a secret hangar contained within the substructure of the ship's forward weapons turrets, signifying it was near or within said area. [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] brought his cousin [[Ben Skywalker]] here, where he put him in the Embrace of Pain and, unsuccessfully, tortured him in an attempt to turn him to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]].
